summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K attaching its third-quarter 2026 interim report released October 15, 2026, a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings disclosure rather than a special situation. Reported sales were SEK 59.5b with 7% organic growth; adjusted EBITA fell to SEK 10.1b (17.0% margin) and net income was SEK 5.8b, or SEK 1.77 diluted EPS. The release notes asset divestitures including iconectiv and an operating-structure simplification, but states no transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation. Capital returns of SEK 4.8b in buybacks continued; net cash was SEK 60.7b. Watch restructuring charges and component-cost margin pressure.
